name: Article 3, § 1, point 5 – 60
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: 5. ‘placing on the market’ means the sale, offering for sale, distribution or any other form of transfer of ownership or responsibility of dogs or cats in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge, as well as the advertising of dogs or cats online;
